resources.string: Address lookup is off in Offline maps only
Looking up an address uses an online service, so OSHI won\'t send what you type anywhere. Turn off “Offline maps only” in Settings, or pick a starting point and destination on the map.
No place search in this region
This region is published without a places database, so searching for shops, stations or restaurants inside it will return nothing. Map tiles and streets still work.
Download the offline region covering this area to search places without a connection.
This region has no places database

The region you downloaded is published without a places index, so place search can\'t return anything here — this isn\'t a network problem and retrying won\'t help. Street search and map tiles still work.
Some downloaded regions have no places database
No match found. Note that %1$s ships without a places index, so nothing inside it can be found by place search.
